title: 计划与投递持久化
scope: unit_fake: real SQLite + real TaskStore transactions; models/control are not exercised here.

environment.host_version: AstrBot 4.26.7 present at D:/Code/AstrBot-latest (read-only, not on PYTHONPATH)

changed_files.note: additive init_extension_tables() DDL hook only; no existing method changed, no table dropped

interfaces.UpperStore.__init__(store, *, clock, rec: reuses the caller's TaskStore connection; never opens a second long-lived DB or nests BEGIN
interfaces.claim_input(*, platform, origin, source_: deterministic sha256 claim key over the identity triple; text is never used for dedupe
interfaces.save_result(input_key, result, *, genera: one transaction; same result replays the same ids, different result is id_conflict
interfaces.reserve_batch(plan_id, *, peer, ex_sessi: freezes C01 envelope + payload_hash; one batch per plan (unique index)
interfaces.record_delivery(batch_id, phase, *, erro: phases received/injected/rejected/delivery_unknown; only the batch's own segments move
interfaces.claim_public_reply(plan_id) -> (reply, c: single public exit per plan, claimed before send
interfaces.get_plan(plan_id) / list_plans(limit, of: read-only projection for B07; snapshot bodies withheld, hashes exposed
interfaces.recover() -> counts: sending -> delivery_unknown + fence, pending left pending, no auto-resend
interfaces.normalize_result(result): route/field combination, 64-segment, 4096-char and 256 KiB guards; refuses rather than truncating

dependencies.need: UpperResult / TrustedUpperInput / InjectionBatch field names; canonical JSON hash must match payload_hash()
dependencies.state: not present in this worktree; consumed through the documented C01 field surface

entry_points: None yet. B10 constructs UpperStore(TaskStore) during plugin initialise and calls recover() implicitly through the constructor.

known_issues: Suffix continuation is intentionally absent: reserve_batch returns the existing batch, so segment 3 of a send_count=2 plan stays pending forever in this round.
recover() is process-scoped: a batch already terminal at delivery_unknown is never revisited, which is the intended conservative behaviour but means an operator must open a new input to retry.
payload_hash() duplicates B00's canonical hash by design (C01 recipe). It is injectable (hasher=) so B10 can wire upper_contracts' implementation when B00 lands.
rollback: Disable the new feature; the upper_* tables remain and older builds ignore them. Reverting the commit removes only the new module and the additive DDL hook.
